item.enigmatic_scythes.scythe_of_curse.t: §5GAMBLE YOUR LIFE AWAY | Hitting an enemy causes them to gain either a debuff or a buff. Right clicking does the same to you.
item.enigmatic_scythes.arachnid_scythe.t: Right clicking sends a barrage of cobwebs forward, sticking to the ground and striking enemies, slowing them down and dealing damage, and setting them aflame.
